senses.gloss: (b. h.; = צאצא, v. יָצָא) to come forth; to shine; to bloom.

units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:5">Koh. R. to XII, 5</cite> <he>מהיכן אדם מֵצִין</he> some ed. (oth. <he>מֵנֵיץ</he>, v. <cite ref="N01139"><he>נָצַץ</he></cite>) from what part of the body will man sprout forth (at resurrection)? Yalk. ib. 979 <he>משעה שהוא מֵצִיץ</he> (Koh. R. l. c. 7 <he>משיניץ</he>) from the time of blooming; Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2); a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>מהיכן הקב״ה מציץ וכ׳</he> from what part will the Lord cause man to sprout forth?, v. supra; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>; Yalk. Koh. l. c. <he>מכין</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Yoma 67a:9">Yoma 67ᵃ</cite> <he>היו מְצִיצִין ורואין וכ׳</he> they looked out to see &c.; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 31b">R. Hash. 31ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 47b:5">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>הֵצַצְתִּי בו</he> I looked at him.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 19:10">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XIX</cite> <he>והֵצִיצוּ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00302"><he>פּוֹעֵל</he></cite>; a. fr.—
Yoma 35ᵇ הֵצִיצוּ עיניהן they made their eyes look around (Ms. M. 2 הציצו only).

senses.gloss: to be made to bloom; to break forth.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 66a:12">Kidd. 66ᵃ</cite> (in a historical fragment) <he>וַתּוּצַץ הרעה ע״י וכ׳</he> and the evil broke forth (took its start) through the agency of Elazar &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 131a">Sabb. 131ᵃ</cite> <he>אם צ׳ טליתו</he> (Ms. M. <he>עשה ציץ לט׳</he>) if he put fringes on his cloak (on the Sabbath).—Part. pass. <he>מְצוּיָּיץ</he>; f. <he>מְצוּיֶּיצֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְצוּיָּיצִין</he>; <he>מְצוּיָּיצוֹת</he>. Ib. 25ᵇ <he>סדינין המצ׳</he> linen cloaks provided with woolen fringes.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite>; a. e.
